subject.title: fix(copilot): bound BYOK proxy request bodies

question: Should `destroyOnError: false` become a supported public plugin SDK contract for response-owning callers such as the Copilot BYOK proxy?
rationale: The bug fix needs a way to preserve the socket long enough to return an HTTP error, but exposing caller-owned teardown permanently expands the plugin SDK and requires a clear cleanup contract.

options.title: Approve the narrow SDK option
options.body: Keep the backward-compatible default, document that false transfers cleanup ownership, and fix BYOK to wait for response completion before destroying the request.

options.title: Keep teardown out of the SDK
options.body: Replace the public flag with a narrower response-owning helper or Copilot-local implementation so external plugins cannot opt out of automatic cleanup.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow SDK option
recommendation.body: Keep the backward-compatible default, document that false transfers cleanup ownership, and fix BYOK to wait for response completion before destroying the request.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal connects this owner to the shared request-body ingress path that defines the proposed SDK contract.
